Send this back

Copy this into the chat. It is the exact command, and any notes you typed come with it.

python -m lib.photo_prep.prep inventory/more-mags-444/folio-mailer --approve-stage orientation

If Copy does nothing, select the text above — the page works either way.

How each frame will be framed. A frame that refuses a crop says why; those refusals are deliberate, and a detail macro with no studio behind it is supposed to refuse. You can force one anyway.
